scope.geometry: Evaluation of an untrimmed torus surface under an explicit local decoded-field parameterization
scope.parameterization: center + (majorRadius + minorRadius*cos(v)) * (cos(u)*unitUDirection + sin(u)*(unitAxis cross unitUDirection)) + minorRadius*sin(v)*unitAxis
scope.frame_contract: Finite nonzero axis and U direction; the U direction is projected into the axis-normal plane only after its normalized axial residual is within the caller's finite nonnegative dimensionless tolerance
scope.numeric_policy: Evaluate six products per coordinate using exponent-scaled products and compensated sums; reject non-finite or unrepresentable results atomically
non_claims: normative ACIS parameter direction, orientation, or trim semantics
B-rep validity, manifoldness, or shell closure
